description: A colored pointer cursor with a user-name label or avatar, used to show collaborator cursor positions on a canvas or page.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name shown below the cursor (or as fallback when no avatar is provided).

props.name: color
props.description: Color for the cursor and label (any CSS color).

props.name: display
props.description:
What to render next to the pointer.
- `"name"` (default): a small colored label with the user's name
- `"avatar"`: a circular avatar image (requires `avatarUrl`)

props.name: avatarUrl
props.description: Optional avatar image URL. Used when `display="avatar"`.

props.name: absolute
props.description: Use absolute positioning instead of fixed. Useful inside relative containers.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the container.
